name: v74_export_sales_low_exposure_stability
hypothesis: Lower and more stable export-sales exposure may identify companies less exposed to cross-border demand and tariff/currency shocks, while avoiding the stopped FX translation fields.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_salexg)) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_salexg) / abs(sales), 252)), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Uses fnd6_salexg export-sales VECTOR via vec_avg; not a domestic/FX translation field.

name: v74_export_sales_positive_demand
hypothesis: Sustained export sales relative to total sales may capture international demand strength; this tests the opposite sign of low-exposure stability.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(fnd6_salexg) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_salexg) / abs(sales), 252), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Sign test for export-sales demand strength; close if it maps back to stopped foreign/FX capacity.

name: v74_other_costs_relief
hypothesis: Lower other costs and expenses relative to assets may proxy cleaner operating cost structure without using stopped SG&A/R&D guidance or compensation routes.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_ocaxs)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_ocaxs) / assets, 252)), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 126), industry)
notes: Low-user FND6 other-cost VECTOR; avoids analyst cost guidance and stock-comp/employee-liability fields.

name: v74_discontinued_operations_cleanliness
hypothesis: Lower discontinued-operations charges may identify cleaner ongoing operations and fewer non-core disposal shocks.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_doq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_doq) / assets, 252)), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests FND6 discontinued-operations event vector; not a restructuring/goodwill impairment sibling.

name: v74_export_cost_discontinued_composite
hypothesis: A broad operational disclosure cleanliness basket may work if no single FND6 cold field is strong enough on its own.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_salexg)) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_ocaxs)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_doq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Composite of three low-use FND6 operational disclosure fields; abandon if weaker than individual legs.
